test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work separately in 10, 20 and 40 days, respectively. In how many days will the work be completed if A is assisted by both B and C every third day?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(10, 20, 40) = 40 units.

Daily efficiency: A = 4, B = 2, C = 1.

Work in one 3-day cycle = A + A + (A + B + C) = 4 + 4 + 7 = 15 units.

Work done in 6 days (2 cycles) = 30 units, leaving 10 units of remaining work.

Next 2 days, A completes 8 units (4 × 2). The remaining 2 units are done by A, B, and C in 2/7 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 ²/₇ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**</p
